snippet.title: Laser Guy  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656610

Originally a winning entry of the GMTK Game Jam 2020, Laser Guy is a comedic twin-stick anti-shooter where you play as a stressed developer whose anxiety triggers uncontrollable laser beams. Navigate chaotic studios, solve explosive puzzles, and reach safety without hurting anyone, because in this industry, there's always a risk of getting fired.
